_comment: Known-stale evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py fails on any report whose recorded input hash no longer matches the committed input ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades one such failure to a loud note -- and only that one: the waiver names the exact report, the exact check, and the exact stale hash. It SELF-EXPIRES: once the evidence is regenerated, the recorded_hash below no longer matches and the checker fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue. Waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call.

waivers.reason: Issue #573's grid-constrained RPU fold regenerated bandgap_startup.gds (block 44.772 -> 48.74 um wide; the GDS is now sha256:97e4ee51...), so this report's input-gds anchor names the pre-#573 GDS. Re-extracting under the DR-0016 pin was measured (device counts and classes unchanged; RPU's own parasitic values and the nets routed around the wider block move), but shipping it breaks the actively cited item-8 characterization inventory (measurements/2026-11-18-characterization-report/dependencies.json dut[6] pins bandgap_startup.pex.spice sha256:892cc05e...), whose only sanctioned remedy is a new dated characterization report -- the PEX re-runs stay tracked in #278/#275. The committed PEX evidence stays the audited DUT bytes. Waived until that re-audit lands; the entry self-expires when pex_extract_report.json is regenerated against the #573 GDS.
